Knurl.title: The Unintentional Process
Knurl.about: Matters To Be Acted On, and Comparative Variation were originally one track that I split up because the change in the latter part of the track was so different, that it sounded like a completely different piece. Derive As A Conclusion was recorded in 2022 as a practice session for a couple of shows I was doing in Toronto, and Montreal on August 6, and 13 2022, respectively.
